summary: Trình fuzzer web nhanh viết bằng Go, dùng để phát hiện các endpoint ẩn, tham số và lỗ hổng trong ứng dụng web.
usecases: Fuzzing web applications to find hidden routes and parameters.
Security testing and vulnerability discovery in REST APIs.
Automated reconnaissance and bug bounty hunting.
ideas: Integrate with CI/CD pipelines for continuous security testing.
Combine with other tools for comprehensive web application security scanning.
Develop custom wordlists for specific target domains.
